sentences.text: Whole-blood creatinine was 5.7 on 19 Aug, up 14% from 5.0 on 24 Jun, while serum creatinine was 1.94 on 19 Aug versus 2.05 on 24 Jun; eGFR fell 13% to 15.6 and BUN rose 14% to 17.25 over the same interval.

At the 11 Sep office visit naproxen 500 mg twice daily and hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg were stopped and the evening 70/30 insulin was reduced by 4 units; naproxen was recorded as a suspected contributor to the creatinine rise, and metformin 500 mg, lisinopril 10 mg, and as-needed furosemide 40 mg remain active.

On 13 Sep you rejected the proposed restaging to CKD stage 4, citing a single whole-blood value and asking for a repeat serum creatinine before restaging; an accepted insight noted the two creatinine series disagree at the same timepoint.
One proposal on this problem is still waiting for your decision, and the note documents about three weeks of fatigue, poor appetite, and morning nausea.
